name: Johann Sebastian Bach
bioShort: German Baroque composer central to counterpoint, sacred music, keyboard works, concertos, and suites.

name: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart
bioShort: Austrian Classical composer of operas, symphonies, concertos, chamber music, and sacred works.

name: Ludwig van Beethoven
bioShort: German composer whose work bridges Classical form and Romantic force.

name: Franz Schubert
bioShort: Austrian composer known for songs, chamber music, piano works, symphonies, and lyrical harmonic turns.

name: Frederic Chopin
bioShort: Polish-French Romantic composer whose catalogue is centered on the piano.

name: Claude Debussy
bioShort: French composer associated with color, ambiguity, symbolist atmosphere, and new piano and orchestral language.

name: Igor Stravinsky
bioShort: Russian-born composer of ballet, neoclassical, and serial works with a defining rhythmic imagination.

name: Olivier Messiaen
bioShort: French composer and organist known for modes of limited transposition, birdsong, Catholic mysticism, and vast color.

name: Toru Takemitsu
bioShort: Japanese composer whose music often blends silence, color, nature imagery, and Western modernist textures.
